3240-5147-6462-8347.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Sela triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1981-5147-5789.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1981-5147-5789.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1829-1981-2415-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
1829-1981-2415-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3585-8099.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Prismatic Vista.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-3585-8099.description:
Fetch a land using Prismatic Vista.
When the fetched land enters, Greensleeves and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Greensleeves trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Greensleeves triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

628-6495-7189.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Dread Tiller.
When Dread Tiller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dread Tiller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
628-6495-7189.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1303-1769-4247.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Rot Hulk enters, it and Necroduality trigger.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Rot Hulk.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, failing to return anything to the battlefield.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Rot Hulk.
When the token Rot Hulk enters, it triggers, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

586-4924-5258-5618-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
586-4924-5258-5618-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-6972-7229.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power X or greater, or you have a creature card in your graveyard with power X or greater.
3899-6972-7229.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Ambitious Dragonborn.
When Ambitious Dragonborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

640-1981-2292-2415.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

252-4231-4478-5394.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-4231-4478-5394.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

620-1477-2111.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

254-4153-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Eldrazi Spawn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3455-5241.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3455-5241.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vizier of Many Faces and Sakashima's Student each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima's Student trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3455-5241.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2034-3000-5086-5183-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-3000-5086-5183-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

5147-6872-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
5147-6872-7690--165.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

969-3259-7686.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
An opponent cannot block and kill The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl.
969-3259-7686.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl as attackers.
The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2595-5231--5.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Repeat from step 2.

851-1558-3875-4231-5621.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
851-1558-3875-4231-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Adrix and Nev.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

280-423-1313-1437.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
280-423-1313-1437.description:
Cast Arboreal Grazer by paying {G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Arboreal Grazer spell three times.
Resolve the first Arboreal Grazer copy.
The Arboreal Grazer token enters the battlefield, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

2906-4779-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 3 life this turn.
2906-4779-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rakdos. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

3259-4359-4689.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4359-4689.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Otharri as attackers.
Otharri triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

454-1526-1978.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures.
454-1526-1978.description:
Cause Circle of Dreams Druid to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Circle of Dreams Druid.
Repeat from step 2.

826-2178-6797-6935.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing Otherworldly Escort to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it and Amoeboid Changeling trigger.
Resolve the Amoeboid Changeling trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Otherworldly Escort trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2275-2541-2919.description:
Activate Benthic Biomancer by paying {1}{U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

64-1987-2128.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature, or land that can produce at least {U} the turn it enters the battlefield.
64-1987-2128.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U} due to Hinata, blinking Warden of the Eye and the permanent tapped for mana in step 1.
When Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-2511-6713.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional creature with flash and/or haste
1339-2511-6713.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature with haste or flash.
When the creature dies, Shadow triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

4067-5672-5704.easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
4067-5672-5704.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with power 4 or greater.
4067-5672-5704.description:
Activate Leafkin Avenger by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Leafkin Avenger.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2097-3017-5742-5743.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2653-5411-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
You control at least eight lands.
2653-5411-5720-5721.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Nissa triggers that many times, adding {G} for each land that entered the battlefield this way.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more lands, this combo will net infinite mana due to Nissa's trigger.

Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

969-2105-3557.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block Brago and Combat Celebrant.
969-2105-3557.description:
Declare Brago and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Brago.
Brago triggers, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat each combat phase.

4091-4944.notablePrerequisites: Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
4091-4944.description:
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting itself.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

190-2369-2480-3860-4579.notablePrerequisites:
Overwhelming Splendor attached to you.
Tamiyo, Collector of Tales has at least three loyalty counters.
190-2369-2480-3860-4579.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Eater of Days and creating a token copy under each opponent's control.
Each Eater of Days enters the battlefield, triggering itself, causing each opponent to skip their next two turns.
Activate Tamiyo's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing any card name.
Activate Tamiyo's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning Fractured Identity from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling an opponent's Eater of Days token, creating a copy with no abilities under your control and a copy with abilities under each other opponent's control.
Each new Eater of Days not controlled by you enters the battlefield, triggering itself, causing its controller to skip their next two turns.
Activate Tamiyo's first loyalty ability twice by putting two loyalty counters on it, choosing any card names.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Tamiyo's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing any card name.
Activate Tamiyo's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning Fractured Identity from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling an Eater of Days you control, or, if you control none, an Eater of Days not controlled by the opponent with the fewest skipped turns remaining, exiling it and creating a copy under each other player's control.
Each new Eater of Days not controlled by you enters the battlefield, triggering itself, causing its controller to skip their next two turns.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat from step 8 until each opponent has skipped turns equal to four times the number of opponents you have.
The player of your choice takes a turn.
Repeat from step 15.

232-1622-2232.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying {2}{R}.
Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, triggering itself, Cloudstone Curio and Minion Reflector.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Minion Reflector trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
The Priest of Urabrask token enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Priest of Urabrask from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3670-4508-4875.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
3670-4508-4875.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ingenious Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Ingenious Artillerist is a Pirate due to Conspiracy, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Ingenious Artillerist triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Ingenious Artillerist trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

1703-3483-3783-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cromat, adding one mana of any color.
Cromat dies, triggering Minn's second ability and Fool's Demise's first and second abilities.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Cromat from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Minn trigger, putting Fool's Demise from your hand onto the battlefield attached to Cromat.
Repeat.

1170-2493-2701-4923.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Cabal Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Cabal Ritual, adding at least {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

152-1608-4659.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Triplicate Titan with haste.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Triplicate Titan token, adding {C}{C}.
The Triplicate Titan token dies, creating three 3/3 Golem creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the three Golem tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

708-2459-4050-4753.notablePrerequisites: Clever Impersonator is a copy of Myth Unbound.
708-2459-4050-4753.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rograkh, adding one mana of any color.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from both copies of Myth Unbound.
Repeat.

45-364-1987-3227.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
Repeat.
